cat > /workspace/tmp/accept.py <<'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys

def run(scn):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable,'/workspace/submission/bridge.py'], input=json.dumps(scn).encode(),
                       stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    assert p.returncode == 0, p.stderr.decode()
    assert p.stderr == b'', p.stderr
    out = p.stdout
    assert out.endswith(b'\n') and out.count(b'\n') == 1
    return json.loads(out)

R = {"https://demo.test":"o1","http://demo.test":"o2","https://demo.test:8443":"o3","https://unused.test":"o4"}
def ev(sid,t,**kw):
    d={'sid':sid,'type':t}; d.update(kw); return d
def f(*pairs): return [list(p) for p in pairs]
BASE = f((':method','GET'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test'),(':path','/'))
def blk(sid, status, **kw):
    r = {'sid':sid,'status':status,'commit_at':None,'origin':None,'offset':None,'length':0,'cache_key':None}
    r.update(kw); return r

fails = 0
def check(name, got, want):
    global fails
    if got != want:
        fails += 1
        print("FAIL", name)
        print("  got ", json.dumps(got, sort_keys=True))
        print("  want", json.dumps(want, sort_keys=True))

# 1. statuses
scn = {'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=BASE), ev(0,'fin'),                      # forwarded
  ev(4,'headers',fields=BASE), ev(4,'reset'),                    # cancelled
  ev(8,'headers',fields=BASE),                                   # incomplete
  ev(12,'fin'),                                                  # rejected
  ev(16,'headers',fields=f((':method','GET'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test'),(':path','/'),('X-Bad','1'))), ev(16,'fin'),
]}
r = run(scn)
check("statuses", [s['status'] for s in r['streams']], ['forwarded','cancelled','incomplete','rejected','rejected'])
check("status keys", sorted(r['streams'][1].keys()), sorted(['sid','status','commit_at','origin','offset','length','cache_key']))
check("cancel nulls", r['streams'][1], blk(4,'cancelled'))
check("origins labels", sorted(r['origins'].keys()), ['o1','o2','o3','o4'])
check("unused empty", r['origins']['o4'], '')

# 2. forwarded record
r2 = run({'routes':R,'events':[ev(0,'headers',fields=BASE), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("fwd record", r2['streams'][0],
      {'sid':0,'status':'forwarded','commit_at':1,'origin':'o1','offset':0,'length':54,
       'cache_key':['GET','https','demo.test','/']})
check("fwd bytes", bytes.fromhex(r2['origins']['o1']),
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')

# 3. chunked with trailers
r3 = run({'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=f((':method','POST'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test'),(':path','/u'))),
  ev(0,'data',hex='00ff'),
  ev(0,'headers',fields=f(('x-audit-a','1'),('x-audit-a','2'),('x-audit-b','3'))),
  ev(0,'fin')]})
check("chunked bytes", bytes.fromhex(r3['origins']['o1']),
      b'POST /u HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ntransfer-encoding: chunked\r\ntrailer: x-audit-a, x-audit-b\r\n\r\n'
      b'2\r\n\x00\xff\r\n0\r\nx-audit-a: 1\r\nx-audit-a: 2\r\nx-audit-b: 3\r\n\r\n')
check("chunked length", r3['streams'][0]['length'], len(bytes.fromhex(r3['origins']['o1'])))

# 4. cookie merge at first position
r4 = run({'routes':R,'events':[ev(0,'headers',fields=f(
  (':method','GET'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test'),(':path','/'),
  ('cookie','a=1'),('x-note','n'),('cookie','b=2'))), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("cookie merge", bytes.fromhex(r4['origins']['o1']),
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncookie: a=1; b=2\r\nx-note: n\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')

# 5. content-length normalization
r5 = run({'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=f((':method','POST'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test'),(':path','/'),
     ('content-length','007, 7'))), ev(0,'data',hex='01020304050607'), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("cl normalize", r5['streams'][0]['status'], 'forwarded')
r5b = run({'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'headers',fields=f((':method','POST'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test'),(':path','/'),
     ('content-length','7, 8'))), ev(0,'data',hex='01020304050607'), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("cl conflict", r5b['streams'][0]['status'], 'rejected')

# 6. FIN order for the pipeline
r6 = run({'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(8,'headers',fields=f((':method','GET'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test'),(':path','/eight'))),
  ev(0,'headers',fields=f((':method','GET'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test'),(':path','/zero'))),
  ev(0,'fin'), ev(8,'fin')]})
check("fin order", bytes.fromhex(r6['origins']['o1']).index(b'/zero') < bytes.fromhex(r6['origins']['o1']).index(b'/eight'), True)
check("fin offsets", (r6['streams'][0]['offset'], r6['streams'][1]['offset']), (0, 58))

# 7. authority normalization and routing
r7 = run({'routes':R,'events':[ev(0,'headers',fields=f(
  (':method','GET'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','DEMO.TEST:00443'),(':path','/'))), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("auth norm", r7['streams'][0]['cache_key'], ['GET','https','demo.test','/'])
check("auth host hdr", b'host: demo.test\r\n' in bytes.fromhex(r7['origins']['o1']), True)

# 8. default port omitted / nondefault kept
r8 = run({'routes':R,'events':[ev(0,'headers',fields=f(
  (':method','GET'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test:8443'),(':path','/'))), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("port keep", r8['streams'][0]['origin'], 'o3')
check("port hdr", b'host: demo.test:8443\r\n' in bytes.fromhex(r8['origins']['o3']), True)

# 9. unknown frames ignored
r9 = run({'routes':R,'events':[
  ev(0,'unknown',frame_type=33,hex='aabb'),
  ev(0,'headers',fields=BASE),
  ev(0,'unknown',frame_type=64,hex=''),
  ev(0,'fin')]})
check("unknown ignored", r9['streams'][0]['status'], 'forwarded')
check("unknown bytes", bytes.fromhex(r9['origins']['o1']),
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')

# 10. te consumed
r10 = run({'routes':R,'events':[ev(0,'headers',fields=BASE+[('te','trailers')]), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("te consumed", b'te:' not in bytes.fromhex(r10['origins']['o1']), True)

# 11. prohibited field
r11 = run({'routes':R,'events':[ev(0,'headers',fields=BASE+[('transfer-encoding','chunked')]), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("prohibited", r11['streams'][0]['status'], 'rejected')

# 12. singleton duplicate rejects
r12 = run({'routes':R,'events':[ev(0,'headers',fields=BASE+[('range','a'),('range','b')]), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("singleton dup", r12['streams'][0]['status'], 'rejected')

# 13. repeatable allowed and kept separately
r13 = run({'routes':R,'events':[ev(0,'headers',fields=BASE+[('vary','a'),('vary','b'),('x-list-z','1'),('x-list-z','2')]), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("repeatable", bytes.fromhex(r13['origins']['o1']),
      b'GET / HTTP/1.1\r\nhost: demo.test\r\nvary: a\r\nvary: b\r\nx-list-z: 1\r\nx-list-z: 2\r\ncontent-length: 0\r\n\r\n')

# 14. exact path preservation
r14 = run({'routes':R,'events':[ev(0,'headers',fields=f(
  (':method','GET'),(':scheme','https'),(':authority','demo.test'),(':path','/a%2Fb?x=1&x=2'))), ev(0,'fin')]})
check("path exact", r14['streams'][0]['cache_key'][3], '/a%2Fb?x=1&x=2')
check("path bytes", bytes.fromhex(r14['origins']['o1']).split(b'\r\n')[0], b'GET /a%2Fb?x=1&x=2 HTTP/1.1')

# 15. empty scenario
r15 = run({'routes':{},'events':[]})
check("empty", r15, {'streams':[], 'origins':{}})

print("acceptance failures:", fails)
EOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/accept.py
